nui 1
record Inner(n: number)
record Box(inner: Inner, xs: number[])
const B: Box? = Box(inner: Inner(n: 23), xs: [7, 19])
const Chosen: Box = match @B { none => Box(inner: Inner(n: 1 / 0), xs: [1 / 0]) some held => Box(inner: Inner(n: @held.inner.n + @held.xs.length), xs: [@held.xs[1], @held.xs[0]]) }
const X: number = @Chosen.inner.n
const Y: number = @Chosen.xs[0]
const Z: number = @Chosen.xs[1]

record Box(n: number)
const B: Box? = none

nui 1
record Shape(p: path)
module Make(x: number) {
 const P: path = segment(start: (0, 0), end: (@x, 0))
 const B: Shape = Shape(p: @P)
 const Values: Shape[] = [@B]
 export const out: Shape = @Values[0]
}
instance One = Make(x: 11)
instance Two = Make(x: 29)
const P: path = @One::out.p
const Q: path = @Two::out.p
const L: number = @P.length
const M: number = @Q.length
const X: number = @P.endPoint.x
const Y: number = @Q.endPoint.x

nui 1
record Shape(p: path)
line Edge = segment(start: (1, 2), end: (4, 6))
move Edge as shifted(from: (0, 0), to: (10, 20))
const Stage: path = @Edge.shifted
const B: Shape? = Shape(p: @Stage)
const Chosen: Shape = match @B { none => Shape(p: segment(start: (0, 0), end: (1 / 0, 0))) some held => @held }
const Result: path = @Chosen.p
const L: number = @Result.length
const X: number = @Result.endPoint.x
const Y: number = @Result.endPoint.y

record Box(n: number)
module Relay(b: Box?) {
 export const out: Box? = @b
}
instance Absent = Relay()
instance Present = Relay(b: Box(n: 43))
const X: number = @Absent::out?.n ?? 31
const Y: number = @Present::out?.n ?? 31

 export const out: Shape = Shape(ps: [@P])
}
instance One = Make(x: 11)
instance Two = Make(x: 29)

const M: number = @B.length
const N: number = @One::out.ps.length
const K: number = @Two::out.ps.length
